purpose: Diagnose feature-count confounding without selecting thresholds by AP or trajectory error
global_control: Select a single raw detector threshold by mean feature-count distance to fixed CLAHE, from the recorded grid
exact_budget_control: Use the lowest threshold in that same feature-count grid, then retain top-response raw features up to each image's fixed-CLAHE feature count; record whether each image actually reaches the target
interpretation: The exact-budget control is a diagnostic counterfactual using the enhanced image's count to define the budget, not a deployable raw-only adaptive rule or a free runtime improvement
primary_metric: all-pair mutual count AP; report achieved per-image count equality separately
